# roqy-audit

> Read-only infrastructure audit skills for coding agents. Audits live AWS, GCP, VPS and Kubernetes environments without changing anything, and produces findings with verdicts: confirmed, needs_validation, rejected.

## What it is

Two agent skills plus a regression harness:

- **live-infra-audit**: audits what is actually running. 70+ checks across AWS (W1-W45), GCP (G1-G10), VPS/Docker (L1-L16), Kubernetes (K1-K18), Terraform (T1-T6), client questions (X1-X9). Includes one-line killers, expiry forecasts, and evidence-based checks derived from real breach data (2014-2026).
- **infra-readiness-audit**: audits the repository layer: secrets in git, CI/CD gates, Terraform state hygiene.
- **harness/**: regression harness. Plants known misconfigurations in a canary account, runs the audit agent, and verifies each planted finding is detected. Current score: AWS 9/9 planted findings detected, repo/vps/gcp GREEN.

## Install (30 seconds)

```
git clone https://github.com/roncoo-2/roqy-audit
cp -r roqy-audit/skills/live-infra-audit ~/.claude/skills/    # Claude Code
cp -r roqy-audit/skills/live-infra-audit ~/.cursor/skills/    # Cursor
```

Then ask your agent: "Run the live-infra-audit skill against my AWS account, read-only."

## Safety model

- Read-only by construction: list, get, describe commands only.
- Network probes are single status-code requests, opt-in per check, and the client can veto any probe at any time.
- Secrets are never printed. Findings reference shapes, not values.
- Every finding carries a verdict. Priority is assigned only to confirmed items.

## Key files

- skills/live-infra-audit/SKILL.md — router and hard safety rules
- skills/live-infra-audit/references/CHECKS-AWS.md — 45 AWS checks with commands and precedents
- skills/live-infra-audit/references/DEADLY-DETAILS.md — small-but-lethal mechanisms explained in depth
- skills/live-infra-audit/references/VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md — verdict model, attack chains, residual risk
- harness/run_scenarios.py — canary regression runner
- docs/runs/ — real canary reports as proof of detection
